*   Cond 6 ($x(2, 0) \lor x(0, 0)$) becomes $1 \lor 0 = 1$. OK.
*   Now check Cond 4 ($x(2, 3) \lor \neg x(0, 0)$): $x(2, 3) \lor 1 = 1$. OK. No constraint on $x(2, 3)$ yet.
*   Now check Cond 3 ($\neg x(2, 3) \lor x(0, 0)$): $\neg x(2, 3) \lor 0 \implies \neg x(2, 3) = 1 \implies x(2, 3)=0$.
